label: copy phase: k fed back as input (recall_idx>=3), strongest when next output is 3 or k
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only (99% of mass) on steps where the input is the letter k, i.e. the model just output k and is fed it back. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, and almost never before recall_idx 3; most mass is at recall_idx 3-5, in longer sequences (L=8-9), with several outputs still left (to_go 2-5). Being a k input in the copy phase is necessary but not sufficient: only about 6-10% of such steps fire. Firing is much more likely, and stronger, when the token being output next is 3 or k (original bigram k3 or kk); the top examples are all k followed by 3 or k at position 3. A small number of weak activations fall on a 3 input. Broad predicate phase==2 & in_tok==k & recall_idx>=3: dev P=0.095, R=0.99, mass recall 0.99. The recorded predicate trades recall for precision.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: k, 3, -, y, o, n; least: i, m, 0, <DEL>) and the token being output (most: 3, k, v, l, p, t; least: f, -, 0, i); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, recall_idx=3, L=9 & t=13.
